variant_policy.absolute_threshold: provisional primary because it matches the current paper definition and supports cross-dataset held-out evaluation
variant_policy.legacy_top_k: parallel legacy variant for the advisor packet; final main-text versus appendix placement is not yet frozen
variant_policy.nucleus_sampling: not implemented and not equivalent to the absolute-threshold model

aggregation_grain.hu_2023_benchmark: Hu public-notebook string-analysis subset; one row per scale; van Tiel scores averaged over three templates
aggregation_grain.ronai_xiang_2024: one row per item-condition; five conditions for each item remain in the same CV group
aggregation_grain.novel_focus: one row per story-trigger-query trial type; all trial types from one story remain in the same CV group

cross_validation.assignment: deterministic sorted-group round-robin within dataset strata
cross_validation.seed_explanation: No RNG is used by fold assignment or the fixed optimizer start grid.

calibration.threshold_rule: one absolute expectedness threshold shared across all dataset rows within each training fold
calibration.scale_rule: one Gumbel noise scale shared across all dataset rows within each training fold
calibration.parameter_reuse: the fitted threshold and scale are reused unchanged for Set, Ordering, Conjunction, and Disjunction held-out predictions
calibration.training_objective: mean Bernoulli item log score within each of ten result rows, then equal mean across result rows
calibration.optimizer: L-BFGS-B with fixed 3x3 quantile-by-scale start grid

reporting.correlation: Pearson r over source-grain held-out item probabilities
reporting.baseline: training-fold mean human response rate for the corresponding result row
reporting.secondary_score: response-level Bernoulli total log likelihood only where exact human counts exist
